content.title: Multi-Character Product Continuity | Persistent Reference Board Audit
content.summary: Keep one registered reference board visible while the hero image relays among at least three clearly adult characters, environments and product duties. Stable identity and package anchors make every change auditable; a causally linked material macro proves the result, and a verified ensemble hands off to a clean product lockup.

quick_start.input_format: persistent registered board showing one original product and at least three clearly adult identities + three stable anchors per adult + fixed product geometry, proportion, color allocation and mark position + solo presentation, coordinated group motion, one use action and one causal material/result macro + every character and scene change remains directly comparable + full ensemble hands off to isolated product lockup and hold
quick_start.recommended_input: Three adult expedition cooks with distinct hair, apron and accessory anchors move through pantry and camp-kitchen duties while a fixed left board verifies the same amber NORTHLEAF tea tin; a leaf-infusion macro precedes a group toast and clean tin lockup.
required_anchors: Register one persistent reference board containing the original product and at least three clearly adult character identities before the first scene change.
Give each adult at least three stable identity anchors and give the product stable geometry, proportion, color allocation and mark position.
Insert one macro material or result proof that is causally linked to the same product.
Reunite all adults before handing off to one clean isolated product lockup and readable hold.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Keep one registered reference board visible while the hero image relays among at least three clearly adult characters, environments and product duties. Stable identity and package anchors make every change auditable; a causally linked material macro proves the result, and a verified ensemble hands off to a clean product lockup.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original product and at least three clearly adult characters in a persistent registered reference board that remains visible while the main image changes. Give every adult at least three stable identity anchors and give the product stable package geometry, proportion, color allocation and mark position. In the main image, relay attention between solo presentation, coordinated group movement, one visible use action, one material or result macro and a final group payoff; after every scene or character change, the persistent board must allow immediate visual comparison. End by handing the group composition to a clean isolated product lockup. The reusable mechanism is a constant visual audit baseline, multi-character role relay, product continuity across environments, material proof and group-to-pack closure—not the source people, faces, hair, clothing, snack, package text, corridor, garden, food layers, palette, layouts, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Register one persistent reference board containing the original product and at least three clearly adult character identities before the first scene change.
invariants.purpose: Creates a fixed audit baseline for every later character and product appearance.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a simultaneous baseline, continuity claims depend on memory and cannot be visually verified.

invariants.rule: Give each adult at least three stable identity anchors and give the product stable geometry, proportion, color allocation and mark position.
invariants.purpose: Separates intentional role changes from identity or package drift.
invariants.ablation_failure: A shared wardrobe color alone cannot prove who or what remained consistent.

invariants.rule: Relay the main image through solo presentation, coordinated group movement and one visible product-use action while keeping the board registered.
invariants.purpose: Tests identity and package continuity under materially different staging duties.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated static portraits do not prove consistency during motion or interaction.

invariants.rule: Insert one macro material or result proof that is causally linked to the same product.
invariants.purpose: Explains what the product delivers rather than offering only character spectacle.
invariants.ablation_failure: A decorative macro with no package handoff breaks the commercial evidence chain.

invariants.rule: Reunite all adults before handing off to one clean isolated product lockup and readable hold.
invariants.purpose: Closes both the ensemble and product identity promises.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on another character insert leaves the advertised object unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source three adult women, faces, hair, bodies, teal clothing and exact styling
the source KRU snack package, wording, red-and-white layout, food appearance and branding
the source persistent lower contact sheet, portrait arrangement, full-body lineup and package-angle layout
the source corridor, peephole, teal room, garden, eating action, group pose, overhead composition and camera path
the source creator identity, Seedream 5.0 Pro and Seedance 2.5 claims, same-author thread wording and 30-second timing
